specification.description: Streetwear blue sling bag in faux leather with a streamlined standard shape, designed for smart casual styling and hands-free everyday carry.
construction_details: Structured faux leather outer with neatly folded seams
Adjustable crossbody strap with padded shoulder section
Top zip opening and compact front slip pocket
specification.care_instructions: Wipe clean with a soft damp cloth and air dry away from direct heat; do not machine wash.

quality_adjustments: Synthetic capacity defined as 70% of external volume, rounded down to 0.1 L, to correct impossible generated volume.
